value.payment: 80% on contract, 20% on approved final draft

figures.finding: Uruguay's directors and screenwriters are represented by DGU (Directores y Guionistas del Uruguay), a member of FESAAL, the Latin American federation of audiovisual authors' societies; its president in 2026 is Diego "Parker" Fernández. No DGU fee scale was found.
